messages:
mira (PM): Need a compact canary widget showing per-route econ: token cost, cache credit, model-delta. Key decision: how to show shared prefetch/cache savings before we have full lineage. Thoughts?

dev (Eng): Keep it simple for v1: credit-first-route by default. Cheap to compute at ingest. Add a tooltip that explains proportional alternative. We'll capture cache_fp + claimed_share on sampled events.

soph (Data): For prototype I can compute amortized saving from sampled_invocations. Pseudo-SQL: 

SELECT route, COUNT(*) n, SUM(claimed_share*model_price_per_token*token_count)/COUNT(*) avg_saving, approx_percentile(latency_ms,0.95) p95 FROM sampled_invocations WHERE sample_tag='econ_canary' AND event_time > now()-interval '1 day' GROUP BY route;

Backfill last 3 days is doable; add shared_cache_group when we move to proportional splits.

kai (SRE): Important: show p50/p95 beside cost. Also enforce stability window (24h rolling) so UI doesn't flip on tiny sample noise. Add canary-block rule: if cost saves >10% but p95 increases >150ms, block shift.

ingest-bot (bot): rollout: econ-sample v1.9 deployed (2026-03-24T12:00Z). default_sample=1%. link: https://internal.redwood/econ/roll/1.9

mira (PM): UX: default to amortized view for product decisions; allow a per-invocation drilldown for debuggers. Include an explain modal listing attribution method and sample rate.

dev (Eng): API sketch: GET /internal/econ/preview?route=...&window=24h -> {avg_cost, avg_amortized_saving, p50, p95, attribution_method}. Implementation: precompute daily aggregates and use read-replica queries for UI. Keep payload tiny.

soph (Data): GDPR note: for Private deployments redact any prompt text; only store cache_fp, token_count, fingerprints. I'll flag backfill to respect org privacy settings.

mira (PM): Acceptance criteria: econ card on canaries, amortized default, tooltip for attribution, per-invocation drilldown for sampled rows, canary-block rule added. I'll write a short RFC and schedule a sync.

dev (Eng): I'll own backend and sampling flag. soph: can you deliver query/backfill by Tue?

soph (Data): Yup, PR by Tue EOD.

kai (SRE): I'll codify alert and add Grafana panel.

mira (PM): thanks team, sync at 11:00.
